times_note: OSH Park turn times are 'time to ship' from ordering, so they exclude transit; boards ship from Lake Oswego, Oregon. Shipping-info page: 'Turnaround times range from 5 business days to 3-4 weeks'. USPS First Class is the $0 default domestic option. The 2-layer Super Swift page still says Super Swift is not available for Four Layer orders, but the services table and /services/four-layer-swift/ list 4-layer Super Swift at 5-6 business days; the newer pages are used. Read 2026-10-14.
layer_rules_note: Per service from docs.oshpark.com: 2-layer 6 mil trace/space, 10 mil drill, 5 mil annular ring; 4-layer 5 mil trace/space, 10 mil drill, 4 mil ring; 6-layer 5 mil, 8 mil drill, 4 mil ring. klayout raises the vendor-wide floors above to the entry for the board's copper count.
impedance_control_note-s: Not offered as a service: no OSH Park page offers impedance testing, coupons or a guaranteed tolerance. The 4- and 6-layer pages publish an 'Impedance Constraint Table' of predicted trace geometry for their fixed stackups (stackups[].impedance_table-ao). Read 2026-10-28
note: Most conservative values used across all services. 2-layer uses 6mil (0.1524mm) trace width but 4/6-layer use 5mil (0.127mm). Minimum drill is 8mil (0.2032mm) for 6-layer, 10mil (0.254mm) for 2/4-layer. Annular ring is 5mil (0.127mm) for 2-layer, 4mil (0.1016mm) for 4/6-layer. No specific silkscreen or solder mask dam specifications found. Via diameter not explicitly stated. Impedance control not mentioned.

stackups.impedance_table_source-s: 'Impedance Constraint Table' https://docs.oshpark.com/resources/six-layer-impedance-table.png (linked from the six-layer page), read 2026-10-28. Columns Design Line / Pitch (traces) print no unit; taken as mil (the page's unit throughout, and 8.3 on the 4.36 mil Dk 3.23 prepreg computes to ~46-50 ohm microstrip, which mm cannot). 'Predicted (ohms)' values; OSH Park offers no tested or guaranteed impedance, so impedance_controlled is false.
